top_signals.title: AI Tech Fears Push Global Credit Spreads to 17-Month High
top_signals.summary:
Metrics across global bond markets are signaling their biggest risk-off sentiment in more than a year, as a selloff in AI stocks and growing geopolitical tensions caused investors to seek out safe-haven assets.
Katy Kaminski, Chief Research Strategist at AlphaSimplex, discusses the equities AI trade test and why fixed income is still under pressure. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.summary: The Swedish automaker cited a deteriorating environment led by "tougher" market conditions in China and the U.S., which "negatively affected free cash flow."
